planets.name: WASP-85 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-85 A with a 2.66-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: WASP-85 A b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-85 A. Its orbit and size follow Močnik et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
